name: Finnish Patent and Registration Office (PRH) open data
summary: Finland's Trade Register through the YTJ open data API: search companies by name, Business ID, town, form or industry, plus the digital financial statements companies have filed.
notes: Keyless and free, licensed CC BY 4.0: credit PRH as the source.
Only companies registered or pending in the Trade Register are covered.
A Business ID (Y-tunnus) is 7 digits, a hyphen and a check digit, e.g. 0112038-9.
Results come 100 per page. A page past the last returns the first page on company search but an empty answer on the financial statement calls. Too many requests answer 429.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies by current or previous name, Business ID, town, company form, industry, postcode or registration dates, with names, addresses, forms, business lines and registry entries.

name.description: Company name; matches current, previous, parallel and auxiliary names.

businessId.description: Business ID, e.g. 0112038-9: a direct lookup.

location.description: Town or city of the registered office.

companyForm.description: Company form code (code list YRMU), e.g. OY limited company, OYJ public limited company, KY limited partnership, AY general partnership.

mainBusinessLine.description: Main line of business: a Statistics Finland TOL 2008 code or text.

postCode.description: Postcode of the street or postal address.

businessIdRegistrationStart.description: Business ID granted on or after, yyyy-mm-dd.

businessIdRegistrationEnd.description: Business ID granted on or before, yyyy-mm-dd.

notes: Code fields in the answer (forms, statuses, registers) are codes; resolve them with prh.codes.describe.

endpoints.name: Get a code list
endpoints.summary: The labels of one YTJ code list (company forms, registers, statuses, business lines, bankruptcy and more) in English, Finnish or Swedish.

code.description: The code list, e.g. YRMU company forms, REK registers, TOIMI business lines, KONK bankruptcy.

endpoints.name: List a company's financial periods
endpoints.summary: The financial periods for which a company has filed digital financial statements.
notes: Only digitally filed (XBRL) statements are covered; take a period's end date to prh.financials.get.

endpoints.name: Get a financial statement
endpoints.summary: A company's digital financial statement data for the period ending on a given date.

financialDate.description: End date of the financial period, yyyy-mm-dd.

endpoints.name: List companies by financial period end
endpoints.summary: Companies that filed digital financial statements for a period ending on a given date.

financialDate.description: End date of the financial period, yyyy-mm-dd.

endpoints.name: List statements filed in a date range
endpoints.summary: Companies whose digital financial statements were registered between two dates.

registeredDateStart.description: Registered on or after, yyyy-mm-dd; data starts 1 July 2023.
